title: A live check's own environment fault leaves the account usable and names the check's fault in one line
description: A live account check that fails because of its own environment (a read-only Pi home hitting EROFS on settings.json.lock, an agy scratch home failure, or a missing model alias in the launch) leaves the account's quota mark unchanged and records the fault once as attention instead of marking the account broken; a real provider limit sentence still holds the account. On the served dashboard at 1280 px and 390 px, the Workers page shows a logged-in Pi account whose check hit a read-only home as usable, with one plain line naming the check's fault, not as broken.
